content.text: Enjoy Live Lakers Games Home or On The GoEnjoy live Lakers games with Spectrum SportsNet+, plus a full archive of Backstage Lakers and other exclusive content.Most PopularMonthlyStream Every game live or on-demand, plus around-the-clock Lakers coverage on Spectrum SportsNet.Season-LongStream Every game live or on-demand, plus around-the-clock Lakers coverage on Spectrum SportsNet.Unfortunately, you are not eligible for Spectrum SportsNet+ because you are located outside of the distribution areaInstead, please check out NBA League Pass and get access to hundreds of live games across the league, 24/7 coverage and highlights.Watch Spectrum SportsNet+Current Spectrum SportsNet+ subscribers can sign in with their NBA ID to watch. Spectrum Internet + Mobile customers can sign in with their Spectrum account credentials to watch. Cable/satellite customers with Spectrum SportsNet can sign in with their TV provider credentials to watch.Are you a cable/satellite customer?You can also watch Spectrum SportsNet from the SportsNet iOS or Android app.Frequently Asked QuestionsSpectrum SportsNet+ is a 24/7 digital stream of Spectrum SportsNet that is available to fans without a cable or satellite subscription living in the Lakers local broadcast territory. Spectrum SportsNet+ includes over 70 live Lakers games during the 2024-25 season as well as pregame and postgame coverage and Emmy Award-winning original Lakers programming. Spectrum SportsNet+ is available exclusively on NBA.com and the NBA App.70+ local games are available for live and on-demand viewing on Spectrum SportsNet+. Lakers games exclusively broadcasted by ABC or TNT will not be available on Spectrum SportsNet+. In addition to live games, Spectrum SportsNet+ includes comprehensive pregame and postgame coverage and award-winning original programming including “Backstage: Lakers”. On-Demand viewing of completed Lakers games, original programming, and special coverage of historical events such as statue ceremonies and jersey retirements will also be available.To watch, login with your NBA ID to watch Lakers games on NBA.com or the NBA app on your preferred device, whether that’s your phone, tablet, computer or smart TV.Yes, monthly subscriptions will automatically renew. Annual subscriptions will expire on September 30th, 2025.Spectrum SportsNet+ is available exclusively on NBA.com and the NBA App. The NBA App is available across a wide range of devices including Xumo Stream Box, Xumo TV, iPhone, iPad, Android mobile, AppleTV, Roku, Android TV, Amazon Fire, Hisense, PlayStation and Xbox.Spectrum SportsNet+ is available to anyone who lives inside the Lakers local broadcast territory. That includes all of Southern California, Hawaii and parts of Southern Nevada.No. You must reside within the Lakers local broadcast territory. If you reside outside the territory, local Lakers games are available via an NBA League Pass package.Yes. Spectrum video customers who receive SportsNet as part of their service will be able to access Spectrum SportsNet+ via authentication. Current Spectrum SportsNet subscribers can also live stream games on the Spectrum SportsNet App.Yes. Spectrum SportsNet+ is available to subscribers when they travel domestically within a 30-day period.Sharing account login information is not allowed. Each account is enabled for viewing on one device only. If more than one person is logged in, the first viewer is logged out.No. DVR is not available on Spectrum SportsNet+. However, game replays are available approximately 3 hours after a game has completed, as well as On Demand episodes for programs like “Backstage: Lakers.”Spectrum SportsNet+ offers year-round coverage of the Lakers. Off-season coverage includes new episodes of “Access SportsNet: Lakers” every week as well as comprehensive coverage of the NBA Draft, Free Agency and Summer League. In addition, Spectrum SportsNet+ offers 15+ live L.A. Sparks games.If you are experiencing technical issues, please submit a request through the NBA Help Center.
